text: "I thank you, God. You were angry but your anger wasn't forever. You withdrew your anger and moved in and comforted me.
I trust, I won't be afraid. God—yes God!—is my strength and song, best of all, my salvation!"
"Give thanks to God. Call out his name. Ask him anything! Shout to the nations, tell them what he's done, spread the news of his great reputation!
Let the whole earth know what he's done!
The Greatest lives among you: The Holy of Israel."
